cards.ex: I've been racking my brains all day, but I can't remember where I parked the car.
cards.exUz: Men butun kun boshimni qotirdim, lekin mashinani qayerga qo'yganimni eslay olmayapman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir eslash yoki yechim topish uchun juda qattiq o'ylamoq.

cards.ex: I had a mental block during the exam and couldn't remember the formula.
cards.exUz: Imtihon paytida aqliy to'siq bo'ldi va formulani eslay olmadim.
cards.uzDef: Nimani eslash yoki bajarishda qiyinchilik, aqliy tutilish.

cards.ex: It suddenly dawned on me that I had forgotten my passport.
I'm trying to wrap my head around this new software, but it's so complicated.
cards.exUz: Men bu yangi dasturni tushunishga harakat qilyapman, lekin u juda murakkab.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qiyin narsani tushunishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: The possibility of losing my job has been at the back of my mind.
cards.exUz: Ishdan ayrilish ehtimoli doimo ong ostida turibdi.
cards.term: at the back of my mind
cards.uzDef: To'liq o'ylanmagan, lekin doimiy mavjud bo'lgan fikr.

cards.ex: I had a senior moment and forgot where I put my keys.
cards.exUz: Menda bir unutuvchanlik bo'ldi va kalitlarimni qayerga qo'yganimni unutdim.
cards.uzDef: Kattalarga xos bo'lgan kichik unutuvchanlik, xotira pand berishi.

cards.ex: His judgment was clouded by anger, leading to a bad decision.
cards.exUz: Uning fikri g'azabdan xiralashgan edi, bu esa yomon qarorga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri qaror qabul qilishga xalaqit beradigan hissiyotlar yoki stress.

cards.ex: In retrospect, I should have taken the job offer.
cards.exUz: Orqaga nazar tashlasak, men ishdagi taklifni qabul qilishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishga qarab, keyin anglab yetgan holda.

cards.ex: She's very quick on the uptake; she understood the instructions immediately.
cards.exUz: U juda tez fahmlaydi; u ko'rsatmalarni darhol tushundi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsalarni tez va oson tushunadigan.

cards.ex: I tried to remember her name, but I drew a blank.
cards.exUz: Men uning ismini eslashga harakat qildim, lekin eslay olmadim.
cards.uzDef: Nimani eslashga harakat qilib, hech narsani eslay olmaslik.

cards.ex: I lost track of time while I was reading that book.
cards.exUz: Men kitobni o'qiyotganimda vaqtni unutib qo'ydim.

cards.ex: I had a brainwave – why don't we just ask for help?
cards.exUz: Menda bir fikr paydo bo'ldi – nega biz yordam so'ramaymiz?
cards.uzDef: To'satdan paydo bo'lgan ajoyib fikr yoki g'oya.

cards.ex: She likes to think aloud when she's trying to solve a problem.
cards.exUz: U muammoni hal qilishga harakat qilganda, ovoz chiqarib o'ylashni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylayotganingizni baland ovozda aytish, fikringizni ifodalash.

cards.ex: Why anyone would want to do that is beyond me.
cards.exUz: Nima uchun kimdir buni qilishni xohlashi men uchun tushunarsiz.
cards.uzDef: Men uchun tushunish qiyin yoki imkonsiz narsa.

cards.ex: The details are still fresh in my mind, so I can give you a full report.
cards.exUz: Tafsilotlar hali esimda yaxshi, shuning uchun sizga to'liq hisobot bera olaman.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsa yaqinda sodir bo'lgani uchun, hali yaxshi esda saqlanib qolgan.

cards.ex: Don't second guess yourself; you made the right decision.
cards.exUz: O'zingizga shubha qilmang; siz to'g'ri qaror qildingiz.
cards.uzDef: O'z qarorlaringizga yoki fikrlaringizga shubha qilish, ishonchsizlik.

cards.ex: It was just a lapse in judgment; he's usually very reliable.
cards.exUz: Bu shunchaki xato qaror edi; u odatda juda ishonchli.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtincha noto'g'ri qaror qabul qilish, o'ylamaslik.

cards.ex: My mind wanders during long meetings; I can't help it.
cards.exUz: Uzoq yig'ilishlar paytida xayolim uzoqqa ketadi; bunga yordam bera olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni jamlay olmaslik, fikrlar har tomonga tarqalishi.
